source_title: Looking beyond GST 2.0: Why compliance reforms are the next big test - Business Standard
source_excerpt: A year after rationalising indirect tax rates, the Goods and Services Tax (GST) is entering a new phase of reform. The first big reset - GST 2.0, unveiled in September 2025 - sought to simplify the tax structure. The second phase of GST 2.0, announced earlier this month and set to roll out November 1, 2026, is aimed at making the system easier to navigate through simpler registration, faster refunds, wider availability of input tax credit (ITC) and more predictable enforcement.
